note: [L] proves the expansion for the coprime part of Lambda*eta (coprimePart), where the weight mu((q,n^inf))/phi((q,n^inf)) is 1; the identity for the full sum over all n is not formed. Also written with psi = conj chi and psi(b^{-1}) = chi(b).

snippet.text:
theorem Schar_primitive {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (c : ℕ → ℂ) (β : ℝ) :
    Schar ψ (coprimePart q c) β = Schar ψ.primitiveCharacter (coprimePart q c) β := by
  unfold Schar
  congr 1; ext n
  have h := changeLevel_apply_natCast (DirichletCharacter.conductor_dvd_level ψ)
    ψ.primitiveCharacter n
  rw [DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_primitiveCharacter] at h
  rw [h]
  unfold coprimePart
  split_ifs <;> simp

proof_context.conclusion: For coprime-supported coefficients, $S_\psi=S_{\chi}$ with $\chi$ the primitive character inducing $\psi$ (`primitiveCharacter`), i.e. the passage to $\chi^*$.
